name: Hitozuma Yukiho no Baai
original_name: ひとづまゆきほの場合
source:
A university student protagonist Yuu has a crush on a wife
named Yukiho living in the same apartment complex as him.

One day, Yukiho tells him to come to her room but...

Doll House presents to you their first 'Wife' themed work!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE216818.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
大学生主人公优暗恋妻子
名叫由纪穗的人与他住在同一栋公寓楼里。

有一天，雪穗让他去她的房间，但是……

Doll House为你呈现首部以“妻子”为主题的作品！
